scope: Source authoring plans only; no native build or runtime acceptance

H3_ART.claim: ASS material symbols distinguish collision, sphere collision, ladder, breakable, transparency, shadow and lightmap intent; seams require matching owners.

H3_LIGHT.claim: Scenario .light placements are dynamic lights; marker X is emission direction. Their runtime functions are separate from authored static lightmap inputs.

H3_FUNCTION.claim: Type 1 unranged functions are authored constants, including constant colors. Other decoded functions can be evaluated at a specified source input/time.

H3_CBUFFER.claim: Resolved parameter values apply rmop defaults then authored channel overrides; bitmap transforms use scale XY, translation ZW.

H3_PARTS.claim: PartTypeNew: 3 opaque nonshadowing, 4 transparent, 5 lightmap only; flag bit 1 ignored by lightmapper. These are not interchangeable transparency modes.

H3_COLLISION.claim: Surface bits 0 two-sided, 1 invisible, 2 climbable, 3 breakable; material and breakable indices are independent fields.

H3_BREAKABLE_HSC.claim: breakable_surfaces_enable(boolean) controls level surface breakability; breakable_surfaces_reset() restores the surfaces. Together with the H3 '-' material convention these support a BSP surface subsystem, not an inference of whole-instance damage states.

H3_BREAKABLE_BSP_LINK.claim: The BSP-to-object converter removes the breakable flag because loss of sbsp linkage causes crashes. This supports preserving BSP ownership; it does not establish a valid Reach shard/support reconstruction.

REACH_BUMP_DETAIL.claim: Reach has a native bump_detail_map slot and may reuse a bitmap across bump slots. A distinct detail-bump asset is not required. These target references are structural evidence only; the XML exposes display names, not full reference paths.
REACH_BUMP_DETAIL.authoring_policy: Keep the verified H3 retail sampler identity and H3 UV transform, using decoded H3 source pixels. Never substitute Reach cedar/ceder assets. Bark opacity and foliage cutout are separate semantics.
REACH_BUMP_DETAIL.foundry_writer_evidence: h3_import/reach_materials.py parameter_bindings and image_usage; native shader bump_mapping detail option

H3_NULL_MATERIAL.claim: Instance collision can retain material -1 independently of sky. No rendered correspondence plus solid collision flags supports preserving an untextured collision shell; the shader identity is not inferred.

H3_CUBE.claim: DDS face order and per-face mip chains; six-face RGBA8 TIFF cross from decoded source pixels. Target import orientation must be checked by the next native writer.

REACH_MATERIAL.claim: Native Reach shader options and parameter authoring, including alpha test, blend modes and environment mapping.

REACH_TERRAIN.claim: Native shader_terrain group, morph/dynamic morph, four independently selected material layers, material names and terrain parameters.

REACH_FOLIAGE.claim: Native shader_foliage, default albedo, alpha from texture or albedo, translucent material option.

REACH_FACES.claim: Connected geometry ladder, sphere collision only, no shadow, lightmap only, transparency and breakable face properties; breakable collision proxies are invalid.

REACH_LIGHTING.claim: Native static light definitions and instances; emissive material focus and attenuation. H3 frustum blend/angles do not have direct fields.

BREAKABLE_GEOMETRY_PROOF.claim: Every collision ring must match render positions, source planes, boundary edges, area and shader identity. Opposite render copies must have equal UV/color/weights and opposite normals. Complete coverage permits unified two-sided Reach breakable scenario geometry; separate proxies are prohibited. Tool rebuilds target breakable support/IDs from this geometry.
BREAKABLE_GEOMETRY_PROOF.limitations: Limited to completely two-sided breakable definitions with triangle/convex-quad collision rings. Mixed definitions, ambiguous vertices, incompatible corner attributes or unmatched faces remain blocking. No compiled shard payload is copied.

REACH_EMISSIVE_SPREAD.verified_contract: Foundry exports native focus = 1 - degrees(emissive_focus_property)/180; its importer applies the inverse. Area-light conversion sets this property from light.spread. Distances have independent falloff/cutoff properties and unit conversion.
REACH_EMISSIVE_SPREAD.inference: solid_angle_equivalent_cone_v1 treats source frustum angles as half-angles, uses a linear-in-cosine taper and blends angular integrals with the basic focus cone. It is an explicitly chosen MVP approximation, not a claim that either engine uses this photometric law.
REACH_EMISSIVE_SPREAD.preserved: Source bake power, color, quality and distance attenuation; emission remains on the original material faces.
REACH_EMISSIVE_SPREAD.known_documentation_conflict: The mesh-property focus tooltip reverses the spread convention relative to executable export/import and area-light conversion. The plan follows the executable roundtrip without modifying the proven writer.

H3_REACH_SEAM_ACTIVATION.claim: Both runtimes set a seam active only when its two connected-owner bytes are not -1. H3 retains a mapped seam collision material when inactive and suppresses it when active. Reach matches this for mapped seams, but skips an unmapped (-1) IsSeam material. The static slice therefore retains the exact H3 collision face as ordinary native collision-only geometry and retains seam identity for future paired-zone authoring.
H3_REACH_SEAM_ACTIVATION.method: Read-only PE disassembly, assertion-string cross-references and branch inspection. Neither executable was run or patched. No executable/resource bytes are included in this catalog.
H3_REACH_SEAM_ACTIVATION.boundary: This establishes source/target state semantics, not native Tool compilation or runtime acceptance of generated Voi. Repeated identifiers alone never establish neighbors.

PAIRED_TERRAIN.claim: Both games retain four top-level material names; target is shader_terrain rather than ordinary shader.

SOURCE.claim: Per-record source fields, SHA-256 identity, usage, topology, transform, snapshot and XML provenance are retained in the plan and run artifacts.

KIT_HLSL.claim: Both alpha tests sample texture alpha and use cutoff 0.5. H3 default foliage static lighting uses SH/PRT diffuse; back_light is declared but unused there. Reach flat foliage is a diffuse approximation; Reach has foliage_translucency, not a back_light color socket. Wind coefficient zero alone does not remove phase displacement: freeze authored rest geometry by zero amplitude. Terrain morph/dynamic morph preserve the same active RGBA normalization; Reach D3D11 adds 1e-8 to source blend channels before division.

REACH_GLOBAL_SEAM_OWNERSHIP.claim: A valid Reach seam is owned globally by the scenario and persists across zones that load both, one, or neither owner. Runtime connection activation requires both owner BSPs; authored scenario membership is distinct from the active zone mask.

stock_example.correspondence: Same global seam index, identifier and 191 valid edge mappings in each owner; two cluster centers match in opposite cluster ordering.

REACH_GLOBAL_SEAM_OWNERSHIP.writer_contract: Native paired seam uses associated-BSP regions and reversed back-facing topology; the authoring region set must contain both owners. The sidecar emits scenario-level structure_seams. Active zone membership is stored separately in scenario BSP masks.
REACH_GLOBAL_SEAM_OWNERSHIP.import_limit: Paired reconstruction helpers exist, but BSP seam discovery is commented out in the current main scenario import path. This evidence does not claim working end-to-end seam import.
REACH_GLOBAL_SEAM_OWNERSHIP.bounded_build: Keep the global source relationship and geometry in the plan even when an owner is outside the build. Do not fabricate an unbuilt target reference or add BSP020 to intro_faa. A fully authored target scenario retains its native seam while an owner is inactive.
REACH_GLOBAL_SEAM_OWNERSHIP.verification: Read-only stock tag XML exports and source hashes, combined with the separately verified Reach runtime owner predicate. No Reach tags or Voi assets were written.

H3_BARK_SOURCE_HISTORY.claim: Modders with access to cut H3/Digsite content confirm the historical TIFF exists and its texture content matches the supplied Deadlock copy; the Deadlock name adds only the deadlock_ prefix.
H3_BARK_SOURCE_HISTORY.verification_limit: The unprefixed historical TIFF was not supplied locally for an independent byte/pixel comparison; no exact loose EK bitmap identity is asserted.
H3_BARK_SOURCE_HISTORY.runtime_decision: Verified retail 040_voi outtree_bark.bump_detail_map remains shaders/default_bitmaps/bitmaps/default_vector.bitmap with its source UV transform.
H3_BARK_SOURCE_HISTORY.policy: Historical existence does not imply active retail use. Source-history evidence cannot authorize bitmap replacement or provide pixels to the native material manifest.

rules.meaning: Resolve every active parameter independently; the record takes its strongest remaining restriction
Unranged authored constant channel, including opacity: preserve decoded source value exactly
Freeze permitted cosmetic UV or emissive animation at source input/time zero; never opacity, cutout, visibility or topology
Reach owns native BRDF/reflection externs; foliage wind may freeze at source rest state
Compose verified draw category with independent shader alpha/blend and lightmapper flags
Preserve unassigned solid instance collision with zero render correspondence as collision-only, never sky
Map verified collision flags; unified breakable authoring requires complete local render/collision correspondence
Stage normalized source terrain into native Reach terrain options, layered samplers, transforms and material names
Native foliage texture alpha test; approximate diffuse lighting with Reach flat foliage, retain unused back_light recipe and freeze wind separately
Decode one BC1/BC3 cube as six faces, retain all source mip resources and cube identity
Absent imported index is not an index into another row; recover authored material properties by source identity
Separate documented dynamic .light objects from BSP-owned static bake definitions and instances
Preserve nonzero source power/color/distances; approximate the frustum with a documented solid-angle cone through native Reach focus
Retain scenario-global seam ownership and source geometry; native activation follows zone membership, while the bounded build preserves existing extant source collision
Unrecognized source semantics and missing original records remain blocking
